result.instructions: Tools for RD Station, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deals are in the negotiation stage, and who owns each one?"; "Create a follow-up call task for Monday on the Acme deal."; "Move the Blue Harbour deal to the proposal stage and set its closing date to 2026-12-15.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RD Station data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rdstation_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rdstation_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rdstation_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rdstation_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rdstation_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the connected user
tools.description: Get the CRM user that owns the connected token: name, e-mail, role and teams.

tools.name: rdstation_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the CRM account. Optionally only active or only inactive users.

active.description: true = active users only, false = inactive users only.

tools.name: rdstation_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts. The CRM returns at most the first 10,000 records per request; page through with `page`.

order.description: Field to sort by, as the CRM names it.

direction.description: Sort direction as the CRM accepts it (for example asc or desc).

tools.name: rdstation_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its id.

tools.name: rdstation_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact. Writes a new record to the CRM.

type.description: Phone type as the CRM names it.

organization_id.description: Id of the company (organization) the contact works for.

deal_ids.description: Ids of deals to link the contact to.

tools.name: rdstation_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change the given fields of one contact. Fields you leave out are not sent.

type.description: Phone type as the CRM names it.

tools.name: rdstation_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals (negociações). The CRM returns at most the first 10,000 records per request.

order.description: Field to sort by, as the CRM names it.

direction.description: Sort direction as the CRM accepts it (for example asc or desc).

win.description: Filter by result, as the CRM accepts it (for example true or false).

user_id.description: Only deals of this user id.

hold.description: Filter by hold flag, as the CRM accepts it.

next_page.description: Cursor from a previous reply, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: rdstation_get_deal
tools.title: Get a deal
tools.description: Get one deal (negociação) by its id.

tools.name: rdstation_create_deal
tools.title: Create a deal
tools.description: Create a deal in a stage of a pipeline. Writes a new record to the CRM.

deal_stage_id.description: Id of the stage (etapa) the deal starts in.

user_id.description: Id of the user who owns the deal.

organization_id.description: Id of the company (organization) of the deal.

tools.name: rdstation_update_deal
tools.title: Update a deal
tools.description: Change the given fields of one deal, for example move it to another stage or mark it won or lost. Fields you leave out are not sent.

deal_stage_id.description: Move the deal to this stage id.

win.description: true = won, false = lost (set with deal_lost_reason_id when false).

deal_lost_reason_id.description: Reason id, when the deal is lost.

deal_lost_note.description: Free text about why the deal was lost.

tools.name: rdstation_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines (funis de vendas). Use their ids to filter deals and stages.

tools.name: rdstation_list_stages
tools.title: List stages
tools.description: List the stages (etapas) of the deal pipelines, optionally of one pipeline.

deal_pipeline_id.description: Only stages of this pipeline id.

tools.name: rdstation_list_organizations
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (organizations) of the CRM account.

order.description: Field to sort by, as the CRM names it.

direction.description: Sort direction as the CRM accepts it (for example asc or desc).

user_id.description: Only companies of this user id.

tools.name: rdstation_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks (tarefas), optionally by deal, owner, done state, type or date range.

deal_id.description: Only tasks of this deal id.

done.description: Filter by done state, as the CRM accepts it (for example true or false).

type.description: Task type as the CRM names it.

user_id.description: Only tasks of this user id.

date_start.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

date_end.description: End of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: rdstation_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task (tarefa), for example a follow-up call on a deal. Writes a new record to the CRM.

type.description: Task type as the CRM names it (for example call or meeting).

deal_id.description: Deal id the task belongs to.

user_ids.description: Ids of the users assigned to the task.

tools.name: rdstation_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities (atividades, the timeline of a deal or of the account) by type and date range.

deal_id.description: Only activities of this deal id.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: End of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: rdstation_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of the account and their ids, so you can read or set them on records.

for.description: The record kind the fields belong to, as the CRM names it (for example contact or deal).
